translations.web: A day to build your walls— In that day, he will extend your boundary.
translations.bsb: The day for rebuilding your walls will come— the day for extending your boundary.
translations.kjv: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
translations.asv: A day for building thy walls! in that day shall the decree be far removed.
